dedupe_keys.name: swissbuildings3d 3 0 beta 3d building models of switzerland and liechtenstein

description: swissBUILDINGS3D 3.0 Beta is swisstopo's national dataset of 3D building models with roof geometry and roof overhangs for Switzerland and the Principality of Liechtenstein, improving on version 2.0. Roofs are extracted manually in 3D from digital ADS aerial image strips by stereo correlation, and footprints and facades are then derived automatically. Two models are offered: closed solids, and separated roofs, facades and floors; each building carries attributes such as object type, height, usage or name. Since 2024 buildings are also structured by the federal building identifier EGID and delivered as CityGML 2.0 where available; on 4 June 2026 EGID models covered 19 cantons plus the city of Zurich. Tiles of one sixteenth of a 1:25,000 sheet are offered as DWG (about 40 MB each) or file geodatabase (about 16 MB), with the full geodatabase about 50 GB, in LV95/LN02. Coverage: Switzerland and Liechtenstein. Access: download index on the product page and the 3D viewer. Licence: swisstopo terms of use; free. Caveats: still labelled beta, and a height transformation error fixed in January 2024 affected earlier downloads. Simulation uses listed by swisstopo include noise and air pollution propagation, solar potential, natural disaster simulation and urban climatology. Related records: the Swiss dwellings dataset and the OGC CityGML standard.
